question: Did you ever use those apps that make your face look younger? Well for Odacchi, even if you use it now it would be okay. If my favourite characters Mihawk, Crocodile, and Doflamingo used this app, what kind of baby faces would come out in the photo? Panda
answer: I think I'm okay without the app so I'll pass~. I love new apps though! Yup, that's what they would look like as brats.
name: Purple Panda
